limitations: DMA requires a global flush of outstanding endpoint responses at reset; unidentified late responses and rollback of accepted writes are not supported.
Native im2col resets configuration and allows DONE relaunch, intentionally differing from the explicit Python-compatible branch.
im2col completion is packet acceptance, not a global fence against concurrent PE/NoC writers. Integrated tests keep PE traffic quiescent. Software must keep DMA addresses within mapped ranges.
im2col private image is a static preload; no source image-write API exists.
Original asymmetric controller pure-Python and translation failures are recorded independently. Native mathematical validation does not establish cycle equivalence.
Banked SRAM retains committed data across reset; unlike standalone DataMem it has no logical zero/preload reset.
Per-word DMA accesses use a full 32-bit mask; arbitrary byte-enable formats are rejected in native mode.
